step_by_step_reasoning:
The whiteboard diagram depicts a mobile game backend architecture on AWS.
1. User interactions originate from mobile clients (UserConsumerMobile icon on the left).
2. Requests enter via an Application Load Balancer (ALB).
3. ALB forwards traffic to the core containerized compute layer running on AWS ECS Fargate.
4. ECS Fargate connects to RDS (PostgreSQL database) for persistent game/user data, and interacts bi-directionally with ElastiCache (Redis) for caching to reduce DB load. RDS and ElastiCache also show a direct bi-directional connection.
5. AWS Lambda handles infrequent/maintenance tasks, communicating bi-directionally with ECS Fargate.
6. ECS Fargate, Lambda, and ElastiCache send logs and operational metrics directly to AWS CloudWatch for monitoring.
